query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules) as total_molecules,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules WHERE cas_number IS NULL OR cas_number = '') as missing_cas,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules WHERE iupac_name IS NULL OR iupac_name = '') as missing_iupac,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules WHERE chemical_class IS NULL) as missing_class,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules WHERE chemicalFormula IS NULL OR chemicalFormula = '') as missing_formula;
